title: Tide-Pool Specimen Chronicle
premise: An intertidal inheritance at a seaside specimen room. Achao and Axi are easily confused; the intertidal specimen case goes intact→seawater-corroded→resealed; the glass-bottom observation boat must be avoided after it sinks; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.

states.prime_on_duty: Naturalist Shen Yu in his forties, skin honey-tanned by sea wind, khaki vest and rubber boots, magnifying glass and sampling spoon at his belt.
states.weary_injured: The same Shen Yu weary and injured: vest torn, waterproof bandage on his calf, magnifying glass still at his belt, steps dragging through mud.
states.retired_away: Shen Yu has retired and departed; only his old khaki vest and name tag remain in the specimen room—he himself no longer appears.

states.youth_apprentice: Young Achao: a lean tide-pool apprentice of fourteen or fifteen, sea-green kelp cord in his hair, wet trouser cuffs, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Achao: a sturdy successor observer in his twenties, still wearing the sea-green kelp cord, eyes steady and calm.

states.intact: An oak intertidal specimen case with intact glass lid, compartments holding starfish, limpets, and dried seaweed, labels neat.
states.seawater_corroded: The same specimen case flooded with seawater: glass lid fogged, label ink bled, compartments pooling with brine.
states.resealed: After resealing, the specimen case has clear relabeled compartments, but a pale white salt stain on one corner distinguishes it from the original intact state.

states.intact: A waterproof-cloth tide observation log, pages filled with tide-height curves and species sketches, corners clean.
states.salt_frost_damaged: The same tide observation log covered in salt frost: cover whitened and curling, writing blurred, a crumpled blotting sheet tucked inside.

states.intact: A pale-green glass-bottom observation boat, white wave lines painted on the gunwales, transparent hull for looking down into tide pools.
states.reef_wrecked: The glass-bottom observation boat reef-struck with hull shattered, half-sunk in foam among the rocks, only a listing wreck left.

states.youth_rival: Axi, face and build extremely similar to Achao, but wearing an amber conch brooch, bold and eager to dive first.
states.remade_return: Remade Axi still wears the amber conch brooch, now with dive goggles pushed up on the forehead, expression deeper and quieter.

E7.name: seaside specimen room
E7.appearance: A seaside wooden-house specimen room: sea charts and tide tables on the wall, specimen cases on a long table, breaking surf outside the window.

E8.name: rocky-shore tide pool
E8.appearance: Rocky-shore tide pools exposed at ebb tide, clear pooled water, anemones and small crabs in crevices, footing slick underfoot.

E9.name: breakwater passage
E9.appearance: A narrow passage inside the breakwater, barnacles on both walls, ankle-deep at high tide, emergency lights dim yellow.

E10.name: abandoned lighthouse base
E10.appearance: The basalt base of an abandoned lighthouse, steps crumbling, copper-green railing broken, new tide pools visible in the distance.

E11.name: basalt memorial plaque
E11.appearance: A basalt memorial plaque nailed to the lighthouse base, engraved with Shen Yu's name and years, surface crusted with salt crystals.

E12.name: glass marker buoys
E12.appearance: Three palm-sized green glass marker buoys tied in a string with hemp rope to mark fixed observation points.

E13.name: plastic tourist pedal boat
E13.appearance: A plastic tourist pedal boat, boat-shaped but with no glass bottom, hull stenciled 'Tourist'.

E14.name: Inspector Han
E14.appearance: Coastal patrol inspector Han, build somewhat resembling Shen Yu, deep-blue uniform and silver shoulder bars, cap badge an anchor—not a magnifying glass.

E15.name: specimen-cabinet spotlights
E15.appearance: A row of five small spotlights clipped to specimen cabinets, frosted white shades, numbers stamped on the metal clips.

E16.name: fog-bell hand cranks
E16.appearance: Two brass fog-bell hand cranks hung on the specimen-room lintel, low short notes when cranked.

E17.name: volunteer Xiaozhu
E17.appearance: Volunteer Xiaozhu, at a glance somewhat like young Achao, light-brown hair band instead of sea-green kelp cord, shy gaze.

E18.name: miniature display case
E18.appearance: A miniature display case, compartment layout much like the specimen case but smaller, no real labels, acrylic lid.

segments.action: At dusk, Shen Yu pushes open the seaside specimen room's wooden door and sets his sampling spoon on the long table.
A row of five specimen-cabinet spotlights clips to the cabinets; Shen Yu turns each on and wipes the shades clean.
Two brass fog-bell hand cranks hang on the lintel; Shen Yu cranks one lightly, and short notes echo through the wooden room.
Shen Yu opens the intertidal specimen case and checks every starfish and limpet label.
Shen Yu gazes through the window at the darkening sea line beyond the rocky-shore tide pool.
The intact intertidal specimen case rests at the center of the long table, glass lid reflecting the spotlight glow.
Shen Yu notes today's low-tide times beside the wall chart.
Shen Yu unhooks the magnifying glass from his belt and hangs it back, checking the lens for salt haze.
Shen Yu sorts scattered sample bottles and reorders them by tide level.
Shen Yu sits in the specimen room's wicker chair and rubs shoulders stiff from sea wind.
Shen Yu opens the tide observation log and records today's tide height and water temperature.
Shen Yu sketches a newly seen anemone in the tide observation log.
Shen Yu closes the tide observation log and tucks it into a drawer.
Glare from the intertidal specimen case glass sweeps across Shen Yu's profile.
Shen Yu circles worn label compartments on the specimen case in red ink.
Shen Yu tightens the ink bottle cap and moves it away from the damp windowsill.
On the morning rocky-shore tide pool, Shen Yu greets young Achao as he poles the glass-bottom observation boat to shore.
Achao jumps down from the glass-bottom observation boat and ties the hawser to a basalt spike.
Shen Yu points to the three green glass marker buoys, teaching Achao to read the fixed observation points.
Achao crouches by a tide-pool puddle, studying an anemone's tentacles with curiosity.
Shen Yu explains to Achao how current and tidal range change the species in the pool.
Achao looks back at the intact glass-bottom observation boat, eyes full of longing.
Shen Yu has Achao lean over the gunwale and peer through the glass bottom at gobies in the rock crevices.
Achao tightens his sea-green kelp cord and carefully notes the tide level Shen Yu recites.
In the breakwater passage, Axi wearing an amber conch brooch glances back from behind the barnacle wall.
